create.name: Dr. William Bloom
create.bio:
Meditation, subtle energy and modern spirituality are the fields in which Dr. William Bloom, a British author and teacher born in London in 1948, has spent his working life. Early on he wrote novels and worked as a commissioning editor at Macmillan, then lived for two years on an off-grid retreat in Morocco's High Atlas Mountains, an experience recorded in The Sacred Magician. A doctorate in political psychology followed at the LSE, where he taught as well, and he went on to spend a decade teaching adults and teenagers with special needs. At St James's Church, Piccadilly, he co-founded the Alternatives programme; he has taught at the Findhorn Foundation for many years and served at length as a Glastonbury Abbey trustee.

The Spiritual Companions Trust, an educational charity he founded and still leads, created the first vocational qualification in spirituality registered with Ofqual, and today it brings spiritual wellbeing into schools. His approach is practical and gathers from many traditions: a daily meditation practice, work with subtle energy, psychic protection, and a calm, unafraid attitude to death and dying. Translated into sixteen languages, his books include Psychic Protection, The Endorphin Effect, Working With Angels, Fairies and Nature Spirits and a title on the new spirituality. Online, he teaches through The Shift Network and Watkins Wisdom Academy.

books.title: Psychic Protection: Creating Positive Energies for People and Places
books.author: William Bloom
books.description: A practical guide to staying calm, centred and protected in difficult atmospheres and around draining people. It sets out simple techniques for grounding, shielding and clearing the energy of homes and workplaces.

books.title: Working With Angels, Fairies and Nature Spirits
books.author: William Bloom
books.description: An introduction to the devas, angels and nature spirits of many traditions, and how to sense and cooperate with them. It includes meditations and exercises for connecting with the spirit of places and the natural world.

books.title: The Power of the New Spirituality: How to Live a Life of Compassion and Personal Fulfillment
books.author: William Bloom
books.description: A guide to building a personal spiritual practice outside any single religion, published in the UK as The Power of Modern Spirituality. It centres on three core skills: connecting with the wonder of life, reflecting on oneself and serving others.

books.title: Feeling Safe
books.author: William Bloom
books.description: A practical book on building a sense of inner safety and calm in an uncertain world. It combines meditation, energy awareness and everyday strategies for staying grounded.

books.title: The Sacred Magician: A Ceremonial Diary
books.author: William Bloom
books.description: The diary William kept during his two-year retreat in the High Atlas Mountains of Morocco, where he followed a demanding ceremonial magical practice. It is a personal record of an intense spiritual quest.

courses.title: The Art of Working With Subtle Energy
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course on how subtle energy runs through relationships, goals, leadership, nature's cycles and life purpose. It teaches practices for managing your own energy field and aligning action with natural rhythms.

courses.title: Psychic Protection, Cleansing & Blessings for Compassionate People
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course on energetic protection, boundaries and cleansing for sensitive and caring people. It ends by applying these skills to wider peace work.

courses.title: The Advanced Art of Psychic Protection
courses.description: A nine-module self-paced Shift Network training that goes further into subtle energy, protection, karma, ritual and making talismans. The seven-module introductory course is included.

courses.title: The Magic of Metaphysics
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course in seven core modules on intuition, subtle energies, angels and nature spirits, protection and manifestation. Each session is a recorded 90-minute class with transcripts and exercises.

courses.title: The Sacred Journey of Dying
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course on meeting death calmly. It covers the evidence for life after death, planning one's own transition and supporting others at the end of life, with guided meditations and poems.

courses.title: The True Purpose of Your Soul's Journey
courses.description: A seven-module recorded Shift Network course on the soul's purpose, where the soul goes after death and how it chooses its next life, drawing on mystical and wisdom traditions. It also looks at living with more meaning now.

courses.title: Psychic Protection (Watkins Wisdom Academy)
courses.description: An online video course with downloadable resources, hosted by Watkins Wisdom Academy. It teaches grounding, meditation and boundary skills for staying centred around difficult people and for clearing spaces at home or work.

courses.title: Meditation Masterclass: How to Practise, Teach and Lead Meditation
courses.description: Twelve video lessons with guided meditation audios and a study guide, hosted by Watkins Wisdom Academy. It covers posture, core meditative awareness and practices including body scans, compassion and connecting with nature, for beginners and those who teach.

free_resources.title: Body Scan Meditation
free_resources.description: A free 20-minute guided body scan meditation in William's voice, as an audio file on his website. A simple practice for settling into the body and relaxing.

free_resources.title: New Year Peace & Healing Meditation Script
free_resources.description: The full script of a four-stage guided meditation for peace, with about five minutes of silence in each stage. An audio version is linked from the page.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @wmblo 2.68K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); no Instagram, Facebook or X linked from his site (footer icons are empty placeholders) → ~3K readable → local_hero
flags: Email info@spiritualcompanions.org is the published (Cloudflare-encoded) office address of the Spiritual Companions Trust, the charity he founded and leads; his own site has only a contact form (https://williambloom.com/contact/).
Reputation does not match the tier: 26 books translated into sixteen languages, major publishers (Piatkus, Hay House, Penguin), but only ~3K readable followers and no linked social accounts.

Several Shift sales pages mention anxiety, stress, mental health challenges or trauma in module copy (Psychic Protection, Cleansing & Blessings; The Advanced Art of Psychic Protection) and a 'severe illness' in his own story (The Sacred Journey of Dying); titles and my descriptions are clean.
The Magic of Metaphysics: the Shift page showed a payment option with no amount, so price is 'Contact for pricing'.
The True Purpose of Your Soul's Journey (2021) page carries 'ended'/'closed' tags but shows Register and is listed on his Shift profile as current.
His site says he is mainly occupied with the Spiritual Companions Trust in 2026 and will announce any workshops there.
The Endorphin Effect video interviews are 3–4 minutes and from 2008; kept as they are among his most viewed.
